name: florilex
description: Microfrontend container for the tutorial series (AIML, Go, ...), composed at the edge by a Cloudflare Worker.

scripts.deploy:aiml: pnpm --filter @florilex/aiml exec wrangler pages deploy dist --project-name=aiml-tutorials
scripts.deploy:go: pnpm --filter @florilex/go exec wrangler pages deploy dist --project-name=go-tutorials
